title_translated: ORQA：一种用于大语言模型专业领域知识的岗位现实问答框架
summary_translated: 我们提出了ORQA，一种用于测试大语言模型在岗位级别知识的方法。以往方法要么通过任务定义将抽象的LLM技能映射到岗位，要么依赖难以大规模获取且成本高昂的专业知识。ORQA通过将O*NET岗位与可信的岗位特定网站（如监管机构、执照机构、专业组织和政府出版物）关联，并将其转化为可溯源的问答对，弥补了这两种方法的不足。结合自动化流程与人工审核，生成了一组高质量的岗位相关问题。通过该方法构建的问题集覆盖了SOC中全部21个主要类别中的116个岗位，共来自187个不同网站的480个问题。每个问题旨在考察与该岗位相关的实际技能。我们使用该方法测试了15个最先进的前沿及开源模型。Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4和Claude Sonnet 4.6表现最佳，准确率约为58%-62%；而较小的开源模型表现约为33%-41%。不同岗位间的性能差异显著：医疗相关岗位表现最高（78%），而办公室与行政支持类岗位约为40%。个别岗位（如金属板工和鱼类与野生动物巡护员）的性能几乎为零。我们还发现，开放式问题以及按工资支出加权对模型在此基准上的排名无显著影响。我们认为，利用现有可信的岗位特定信息来评估大语言模型在专业领域的知识，未来可能是一种可扩展且有用的方法。结果与数据可在该网址获取。

summary: Long-term conversational agents must answer user queries by recalling information from extended dialogue histories, yet directly using the full history is costly and often unreliable, while compressed memory units may lose fine-grained evidence needed for question answering. Motivated by the reconstructive view of autobiographical memory, we propose CueMem, a cue-guided framework that treats extracted memory records as retrieval cues rather than self-contained evidence and reconstructs query-relevant dialogue context from their source turns. During memory construction, CueMem extracts fine-grained memory cues from dialogue turns and links each cue to its source turn. At query time, it retrieves query-relevant cues, maps them to source-turn anchors, and expands from these anchors over a turn graph that captures temporal proximity and semantic relatedness, reconstructing a compact evidence context from the original dialogue for LLM answer generation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that CueMem consistently outperforms representative long-term memory baselines. Further analyses show that graph-based context reconstruction helps recover supporting dialogue evidence while reducing query-time input tokens and latency compared with the full-history LLM setting. These results highlight retrieval cues as an effective alternative to self-contained memory evidence for long-term conversational question answering.
title: CueMem: Cue-Guided Context Reconstruction for Long-Term Conversational Memory
title_translated: CueMem：基于提示引导的长期对话记忆上下文重建
summary_translated: 长期对话智能体必须依靠扩展的对话历史来回答用户问题，但直接使用完整历史代价高且不可靠，而压缩的记忆单元可能丢失问答所需的细粒度证据。受自传式记忆重构观点启发，我们提出CueMem，一种基于提示引导的框架，将提取的记忆记录视为检索提示而非自包含证据，并从其原始对话轮次中重建与查询相关的对话上下文。在记忆构建阶段，CueMem从对话轮次中提取细粒度记忆提示，并将每个提示与其来源轮次关联。在查询时，它检索与查询相关的提示，将其映射到源轮次锚点，并基于捕捉时间邻近性和语义相关性的轮次图进行扩展，从而从原始对话中重建紧凑的证据上下文以供大语言模型生成答案。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，CueMem始终优于代表性长期记忆基线。进一步分析显示，基于图的上下文重建有助于恢复支持性对话证据，同时相比完整历史设置显著减少查询时输入 token 数量和延迟。这些结果突显了检索提示作为长期对话问答中自包含记忆证据的有效替代方案。

summary: Large language models trained recursively on their own or other models' outputs undergo model collapse, in which distributional tails and factual accuracy deteriorate while fluency survives. Prior work diagnoses collapse after training; the actionable problem is screening a corpus of unknown provenance before training. We introduce SynthSentry, a corpus-level, model-agnostic contamination signal requiring no access to the generating model, no generation history, and no synthetic labels. The score is a distributional divergence over three statistics: lexical diversity collapse, n-gram tail truncation, and perplexity variance across reference models. We evaluate on corpora contaminated by small open-weight generators and an instruction-tuned open-weight model under a leave-one-generator-out protocol. A domain-stratified study measures false positives on naturally repetitive human text (legal, clinical, source code). The score ranks corpora by severity with little loss when whole generator families are held out. Per-domain calibration holds near its nominal false-positive budget once covariance shrinkage and a bootstrap threshold replace a naive quantile, which runs four times over budget. A downstream fine-tuning check showed no contamination-driven accuracy deficit at our scale, so whether pruning recovers one remains open; the same run shows over-pruning risk once pruning exceeds the true contamination fraction. We frame screening as a data-curation defense rather than a post-hoc diagnosis and release the scoring toolkit. All results are small-scale; scope is English-language, batch-mode corpus screening. Contamination sources are single-generation or hand-authored rather than recursively generated, so results speak to synthetic contamination generally and not to recursion depth.
title: SynthSentry: Detecting Synthetic Data Contamination in Language Model Training Data
comment: 11 pages, 3 Figures, 2026 IEEE Asia Conference on Innovation in Emerging Technology
title_translated: SynthSentry：检测语言模型训练数据中的合成数据污染
summary_translated: 在自身或其他模型输出上递归训练的大语言模型会经历模型坍塌，表现为分布尾部和事实准确性下降，而流畅性仍保持。先前工作在训练后诊断坍塌；但更实际的问题是在训练前筛查未知来源的数据集。我们提出SynthSentry，一种无需访问生成模型、生成历史或合成标签的、面向数据集级别的、模型无关的污染信号。该评分基于三个统计量的分布差异：词汇多样性衰减、n-gram尾部截断以及参考模型间的困惑度方差。我们在被小型开源生成器和指令微调的开源模型污染的数据集上进行了评估，采用留一生成器排除协议。分领域研究测量了自然重复文本（法律、临床、源代码）中的误报率。该评分能按严重程度对数据集排序，即使在整体生成器家族被排除时也损失很小。分领域校准在引入协方差收缩和Bootstrap阈值替代朴素分位数后，保持在名义误报预算附近，而后者运行时超出预算四倍。下游微调检查显示，在我们的规模下未出现由污染导致的准确率下降，因此修剪是否能恢复性能尚待验证；同一运行也表明，一旦修剪超过真实污染比例，存在过度修剪风险。我们将筛查定位为数据治理防御而非事后诊断，并发布了评分工具包。所有结果均为小规模；范围限定于英文批量数据集筛查。污染来源为单次生成或手工撰写，而非递归生成，因此结果适用于一般合成污染，不涉及递归深度。

summary: Authorship attribution models can re-identify users from seemingly anonymized text by exploiting stable stylistic fingerprints, even after explicit identifiers are removed, posing a growing privacy risk for text publishing and analytics. This risk extends to speech-derived text such as ASR transcripts of meetings and call-center conversations, where stylometric leakage can persist even after acoustic anonymization. Differential privacy-based anonymization often severely degrades text quality and utility. We propose a style-aware, prompt-driven anonymization approach that uses pretrained large language models to construct compact stylistic profiles from minimal samples and rewrite text to suppress identifiable style markers while preserving meaning. Across blog and review datasets, our approach reduces authorship attribution F1 by 60-70% while maintaining content quality and readability, substantially outperforming DP-based and non-DP baselines.
title: I Am No One: Style-Aware Paraphrasing for Text Anonymization
title_translated: 我并非任何人：风格感知的文本匿名化重写
summary_translated: 作者归属模型能够通过利用稳定的风格指纹，从看似已匿名的文本中重新识别用户，即使显式标识符已被移除，这对文本发布与分析构成了日益增长的隐私风险。这一风险延伸至语音转录文本（如会议和客服通话的ASR转录稿），其中即使经过声学匿名化，风格特征泄露仍可能持续存在。基于差分隐私的匿名化通常会严重损害文本质量和可用性。我们提出一种风格感知、提示驱动的匿名化方法，利用预训练大语言模型从极少量样本中构建紧凑的风格画像，并重写文本以抑制可识别的风格标记，同时保留原意。在博客和评论数据集上，该方法使作者归属F1降低60%-70%，同时保持内容质量与可读性，显著优于基于差分隐私和非差分隐私的基线方法。

summary: We describe six submissions under the team name ESTS to the unconstrained WMT26 Model Compression Shared Task for English--Simplified Chinese and English--Egyptian Arabic. We submit three compression operating points per translation direction, all derived from GPT-OSS-20B. We use task-specific routing mass to rank experts and cross-lingual routing divergence to allocate retained capacity across layers, then physically remove low-importance experts. The resulting specialists are recovery-tuned on GPT-5.1-generated synthetic translation data and further compressed by applying MXFP4 quantization to the retained expert projection weights. We additionally implement a robust inference system for the instruction-conditioned WMT26 setting, including category inference, output validation, retries, segmented fallback, and source-owned JSON reconstruction. Across our six submissions, parameter counts range from 4.186B to 7.770B and packed artifact sizes from 4.55 to 6.33~GiB. Internal xCOMET-XL evaluation using GPT-5.1 pseudo-references provides an internal comparison across the submitted compression operating points.
title: ESTS at WMT26: Routing-Informed Expert Pruning for Model Compression
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT 2026)
title_translated: ESTS在WMT26：基于路由信息的专家剪枝模型压缩方法
summary_translated: 我们以ESTS团队名义提交了六项参与WMT26无约束模型压缩共享任务的成果，涵盖英语-简体中文和英语-埃及阿拉伯语两种翻译方向。每种方向提交三个压缩操作点，均源自GPT-OSS-20B。我们使用任务特定的路由质量对专家进行排序，利用跨语言路由差异在各层间分配保留容量，随后物理移除低重要性专家。所得专家在GPT-5.1生成的合成翻译数据上进行恢复调优，并进一步通过应用MXFP4量化技术对保留的专家投影权重进行压缩。此外，我们还实现了一个针对指令条件设置的鲁棒推理系统，包括类别推断、输出验证、重试机制、分段回退和源端JSON重构。在六项提交中，参数量介于41.86亿至77.70亿之间，打包后的文件大小为4.55至6.33 GiB。我们使用GPT-5.1伪参考进行内部xCOMET-XL评估，对提交的压缩操作点进行内部比较。

summary: Small models are made more capable through distillation from a larger one that shares their tokenization scheme. However, do distilled byte and token models behave similarly in terms of scaling trends as compute and data increases? To enable this comparison, we introduce two variants to efficiently convert token logits to Byte Logits: 1) approximate: Marginalize-It, and 2) exact: End-Of-Token. We then present the first large scale study of overtraining decoder-only dense transformer models varying two dimensions simultaneously: the tokenization scheme (Tokens, Bytes, Bytes w/ eot) and the training objective (Distillation vs. Cross-Entropy), sweeping layer-parameter-matched models with roughly 1 billion parameters up to 1 trillion bytes of data. Across eight benchmarks spanning three categories: Multiple Choice QA, Language Generation, and Machine Translation, we find that Token-1B models outperform byte models (End-Of-Token-1B and Bytes-1B) in the low-FLOP regime but eventually plateau; byte models start worse yet surpass Token-1B models with more compute, reaching a higher downstream task performance ceiling. Extrapolating the average top-1 error vs. validation BPB scaling laws predicts that, asymptotically, distilled End-Of-Token-1B outperforms distilled Token-1B by up to 4%. They are also far more data efficient, matching the performance of distilled Token-1B using only one-sixth of the training data. Moreover, by operating over a small vocabulary of 256 bytes instead of on the order of 100K tokens, they circumvent the need for top-k truncation during logit dumping, while also reducing logit storage costs to roughly one-fifth. Finally, our downstream performance scaling laws predict that our distilled End-Of-Token-1B models asymptotically surpass the Llama 3.2-1B, Gemma-3-1B-pt, and Gemma 2B models on averaged downstream tasks by up to 6.5%, 8.1%, and 2.1%, respectively.
title: Breaking the Token Ceiling: Distilling Smaller, Stronger Byte Models
title_translated: 突破令牌上限：蒸馏更小、更强的字节模型
summary_translated: 通过从共享分词方案的大模型中蒸馏，使小模型变得更强大。然而，随着计算量和数据量增加，蒸馏后的字节模型与令牌模型在扩展趋势上是否表现相似？为实现这一比较，我们引入两种高效将令牌logits转换为字节logits的变体：1）近似方法：Marginalize-It；2）精确方法：End-Of-Token。随后，我们首次大规模研究了同时变化两个维度的解码器-only密集Transformer模型的过拟合现象：分词方案（令牌、字节、带eot的字节）和训练目标（蒸馏 vs. 交叉熵），覆盖参数量约10亿至1万亿字节的数据。在涵盖多项选择题问答、语言生成和机器翻译三类任务的八个基准测试中，我们发现，在低FLOP环境下，Token-1B模型优于字节模型（End-Of-Token-1B和Bytes-1B），但最终趋于饱和；而字节模型起始表现较差，但在更多计算资源下超越Token-1B模型，达到更高的下游任务性能上限。基于平均top-1误差与验证BPB的扩展规律外推预测，渐近情况下，蒸馏后的End-Of-Token-1B模型比蒸馏后的Token-1B模型性能提升最多达4%。此外，它们的数据效率更高，仅需六分之一的训练数据即可达到蒸馏Token-1B的性能。由于在256个字节的小词汇表上运行，而非约10万级别的令牌，它们避免了在logit输出时进行top-k截断，同时将logit存储成本降低至约五分之一。最后，我们的下游性能扩展规律预测，蒸馏后的End-Of-Token-1B模型在平均下游任务上，渐近超越Llama 3.2-1B、Gemma-3-1B-pt和Gemma 2B模型，分别提升最多达6.5%、8.1%和2.1%。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve knowledge-intensive question answering, but the first design choice is easy to overlook: how should the source corpus be partitioned into retrievable units? Fixed-size chunks often return long passages whose relation to the question is only implicit. We introduce EAR, an Entity-Aware Partitioning approach for multiple-choice question answering (MCQA). EAR extracts normalized surface anchors from the question, answer options, and corpus; retrieves local windows around matching corpus anchors; and can attach a larger parent passage through an extractive summary. We evaluate EAR on a cleaned Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU)-style subset of 153 questions selected by an automatic corpus-support heuristic and using decontaminated public textbook text. Across same-protocol top-k = 3 and top-k = 8 sweeps with Mistral, Gemma, and DeepSeek, EAR entity-window reduces retrieved words by 37.5-40.2% relative to chunks. Observed accuracy changes are +5.2, +1.3, and -3.9 points at top-k = 3, and +5.9, -3.3, and -4.6 points at top-k = 8; none of the entity-window differences is statistically significant. The scoped contribution is methodological: EAR provides a compact and inspectable retrieval unit, while its rule-based anchor extractor remains domain-specific and requires separate validation before transfer.
title: EAR: Entity-Aware Partitioning Approach for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Development
comment: 6 pages. Accepted and presented at the 2026 Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Applications Conference (ASYU 2026). To appear in the conference proceedings and IEEE Xplore
title_translated: EAR：面向检索增强生成开发的实体感知分区方法
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）可提升知识密集型问答性能，但一个关键设计选择常被忽视：源语料库应如何划分为可检索单元？固定大小的块通常返回长段落，其与问题的关系仅为隐含。我们提出EAR（Entity-Aware Partitioning），一种用于多项选择题问答（MCQA）的实体感知分区方法。EAR从问题、答案选项和语料库中提取标准化的表面锚点；检索匹配锚点的局部窗口；并通过抽取式摘要附加更大的父段落。我们在一个经清洗的、由自动语料支持启发式筛选出的153个问题的MMLU风格子集上评估EAR，使用去污染的公开教科书文本。在相同协议下对top-k = 3和top-k = 8进行 sweeps，使用Mistral、Gemma和DeepSeek模型，EAR实体窗口相比块结构减少了37.5%-40.2%的检索词数。观察到的准确率变化分别为：top-k=3时+5.2、+1.3、-3.9分；top-k=8时+5.9、-3.3、-4.6分；所有实体窗口差异均不具统计显著性。本研究的方法论贡献在于：EAR提供了一个紧凑且可检查的检索单元，但其基于规则的锚点提取器仍具有领域特定性，需在迁移前单独验证。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate biomedical hypotheses, but it remains unclear whether they truly reason from scientific evidence or simply produce convincing-sounding ideas. To study this, we combine three major biological databases: the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), Rhea, and UniProt, into a unified biochemical knowledge graph and construct a benchmark of 550 paths connecting enzyme sources to rare disease endpoints, yielding 13,200 hypotheses from six LLMs under four conditions varying the biological information each model receives: source enzyme only, full biological path, or source and disease endpoint only. Hypotheses are scored using an expert-derived five-criterion rubric on a 1-5 scale per criterion. We find that models given both the source and disease endpoint often produce the highest-scoring hypotheses, showing that LLMs can generate compelling ideas from minimal information. However, these hypotheses are less grounded in the evidence. In contrast, models given the full biological path generate hypotheses more consistent with known mechanistic relationships. We call this evidence-disciplined reasoning. To confirm this effect, we shuffled intermediate path steps while keeping endpoints fixed. Evidence grounding dropped significantly (delta = -0.793, p < 0.001), confirming models genuinely used path structure during reasoning. Our findings show that knowledge graphs support hypothesis generation in two ways: they identify biological endpoint pairs absent from the literature, and their mechanistic paths guide how LLMs reason between them.
title: HypoKG: Evidence-Disciplined Biomedical Hypothesis Generation Beyond Endpoint Knowledge
title_translated: HypoKG：超越终点知识的证据约束型生物医学假说生成
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成生物医学假说，但尚不清楚它们是否真正基于科学证据推理，还是仅生成听起来合理的想法。为研究此问题，我们将京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）、Rhea和UniProt三大生物数据库整合为统一的生化知识图谱，并构建了一个包含550条路径的基准测试，连接酶来源与罕见疾病终点，由此在四种不同条件下（仅源酶、完整生物路径、仅源与疾病终点）从六种LLM生成13,200个假说。假说采用专家制定的五项标准评分体系（每项1-5分）进行评估。我们发现，仅提供源与疾病终点的模型常生成得分最高的假说，表明LLMs可在极简信息下生成有说服力的想法。然而，这些假说在证据基础上较弱。相比之下，获得完整生物路径的模型生成的假说更符合已知机制关系。我们称之为证据约束推理。为确认该效应，我们打乱中间路径步骤但保持终点不变，证据基础显著下降（delta = -0.793，p < 0.001），证实模型确实在推理中利用了路径结构。研究结果表明，知识图谱通过两种方式支持假说生成：一是识别文献中缺失的生物终点对，二是其机制路径引导LLM在两者之间进行推理。

summary: The climate literature has grown faster than review teams can read it. That gap matters most for a concept like the environmental social tipping point, the threshold at which a small change triggers rapid, self-reinforcing change in a social system. Evidence of this kind of shift is usually contained in one or two paragraphs within a longer document. As a result, existing text mining tools-which categorize entire documents by topic or highlight isolated claims-leave an expanding set of important evidence without any systematic method for discovery or organization. This paper presents an open and modular transformer-based framework that detects and structures social tipping point evidence at the passage level. The framework joins five components into a single deployable workflow: a DistilBERT boundary splitter for segmentation, an iteratively augmented RoBERTa classifier for detection, a Mistral 7B model that rewrites each detected passage for clarity, a LLaMA 3.2 3B model that rates the passage against five published social tipping point criteria, and a Milvus vector store for semantic retrieval. The system is wrapped in a Streamlit interface backed by MinIO object storage. Evaluated on a 163-passage benchmark labelled by GPT-4.1 and a 51-passage set reviewed by experts, the splitter surpassed three competing methods on a nine-metric composite score (6.137). The tuned RoBERTa model achieved 71.4 percent accuracy with a Cohen's kappa of 0.337 on the full benchmark, and 87.5 percent accuracy with a kappa of 0.742 on passages with labels, outperforming both a climate-focused model and untuned language models.
title: Automated Detection and Structuring of Social Tipping Point Evidence in Climate related Documents: A Modular AI Framework
title_translated: 气候相关文档中社会临界点证据的自动化检测与结构化：一种模块化AI框架
summary_translated: 气候文献的增长速度远超评审团队的阅读能力。这一差距在“环境社会临界点”概念上尤为突出——即社会系统中微小变化触发快速、自我强化转变的阈值。此类转变的证据通常仅存在于长文档中的一个或两个段落中。因此，现有文本挖掘工具（按主题分类整篇文档或突出孤立主张）无法系统发现或组织这类重要证据。本文提出一种开放且模块化的基于Transformer的框架，可在段落级别检测并结构化社会临界点证据。该框架将五个组件整合为单一可部署工作流：DistilBERT边界分割器用于分段，迭代增强的RoBERTa分类器用于检测，Mistral 7B模型重写每个检测到的段落以提高清晰度，LLaMA 3.2 3B模型根据五个已发表的社会临界点标准对段落评分，以及Milvus向量存储用于语义检索。系统通过Streamlit界面实现，后端依托MinIO对象存储。在由GPT-4.1标注的163段基准集和由专家评审的51段集合上进行评估，分割器在九项指标综合得分上超越三种竞争方法（得分为6.137）。调优后的RoBERTa模型在全基准集上达到71.4%准确率，Cohen's kappa为0.337；在带标签段落上准确率达87.5%，kappa为0.742，优于专门针对气候领域的模型及未调优的语言模型。

summary: Inference-time power sampling via Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) can substantially improve large language model (LLM) reasoning without requiring post-training. However, many existing SMC approaches rely on equal-weight resampling, which can aggressively prune low-weight trajectories, discarding potentially correct reasoning paths and degrading the genealogical diversity of the search space. To address this, we introduce Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling (CCPS). Our method applies the Chopthin resampler to LLM decoding: rather than equalizing weights and forcing unnecessary particle duplication, it enforces an upper bound on the ratio between the largest and smallest weights and carries the unequal weights forward. This targeted intervention preserves a richer set of distinct reasoning paths, keeps the weighted SMC approximation unchanged in conditional expectation, and guarantees a lower bound on the post-resampling effective sample size (ESS). To fully exploit this enriched population, we employ a semantic-majority selection mechanism that merges token-identical final trajectories, clusters semantically equivalent answers, and returns the answer supported by the largest number of distinct trajectories. Evaluating across three open-weight models and five reasoning benchmarks, we show that Chopthin increases oracle coverage in 13 of 15 settings. Combined with semantic-majority selection, CCPS matches or exceeds the final-answer accuracy of the Power-SMC baseline in 14 of 15 settings, delivering absolute gains of up to 10.6 percentage points. These findings demonstrate that diversity-preserving resampling and diversity-aware selection are complementary mechanisms for training-free LLM reasoning. Code is available at this http URL .
title: Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling: A Diversity-Preserving Approach to LLM Decoding
comment: Accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
title_translated: Chopthin-共识功率采样：一种保留多样性的大语言模型解码方法
summary_translated: 通过序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）进行推理时的功率采样可显著提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，且无需后训练。然而，许多现有SMC方法依赖等权重重采样，会激进地剪枝低权重轨迹，丢弃潜在正确的推理路径，从而降低搜索空间的谱系多样性。为解决此问题，我们提出Chopthin-共识功率采样（CCPS）。该方法将Chopthin重采样器应用于LLM解码：不强制权重均衡或不必要的粒子复制，而是对最大与最小权重之比施加上限，并保留不均衡权重。这种针对性干预保留了更丰富的独特推理路径，保持加权SMC近似在条件期望上的不变性，并保证重采样后有效样本量（ESS）的下限。为充分利用这一丰富种群，我们采用语义多数选择机制：合并完全相同的最终轨迹，聚类语义等价的答案，并返回由最多不同轨迹支持的答案。在三个开源权重模型和五个推理基准上的评估显示，Chopthin在15个设置中有13个提升了oracle覆盖率。结合语义多数选择，CCPS在15个设置中有14个达到或超过Power-SMC基线的最终答案准确率，绝对提升最高达10.6个百分点。这些发现表明，保留多样性的重采样与多样性感知的选择是无需训练的LLM推理中互补的机制。代码已公开。

summary: Question-answering often requires reasoning across multiple connected facts rather than retrieving a single isolated relation. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide a structured way to represent such facts, but training large language models (LLMs) only on isolated KG head-relation-tail triples may limit their ability to learn the surrounding context needed for multi-hop reasoning. In this work, we propose a context-augmented training framework for multi-hop question-answering. Although generally applicable, we validate the framework in the context of disease-specific KGs, extracted using a reliable KG extraction framework called GraphMERT, for Gastroparesis and Diabetes. For each primary KG triple, we attach supporting triples extracted from the same source text chunk to form a context graph (CG). This creates two supervision settings: KG-grounded supervision, which uses only the target KG triple or path, and CG-grounded supervision, which uses the target KG triple or path together with supporting context triples. We train the Qwen3-14B model using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) under both settings, producing KGModel and CGModel variants. To strengthen the lower-hop factual foundation of the models, we introduce an LLM-judged, history-aware adaptive repair pipeline that identifies unresolved one-hop failures, continually fine-tunes on targeted repair examples, and removes or quarantines problematic noisy triples. This repair stage enables the models to reach 100% accuracy on the cleaned retained one-hop validation sets. Finally, we employ reinforcement learning (RL) using lower-hop question-answer items and evaluate generalization on harder 3-hop, 4-hop, and 5-hop tasks. Across both diseases, context-augmented supervision consistently improves multi-hop performance over KG-only supervision. RL initialized from repaired SFT checkpoints yields larger and more stable gains.
title: Repair Before Reinforce: Context-Augmented Knowledge Graph Reasoning for Multi-Hop Question Answering
title_translated: 修复在强化之前：面向多跳问答的上下文增强知识图谱推理
summary_translated: 问答任务通常需要跨越多个相互关联的事实进行推理，而非仅检索单一孤立的关系。知识图谱（KG）为表示此类事实提供了结构化方式，但仅基于孤立的KG头-关系-尾三元组训练大语言模型（LLMs）可能限制其学习多跳推理所需周围上下文的能力。本文提出一种面向多跳问答的上下文增强训练框架。尽管该框架具有通用性，我们将其应用于通过可靠的知识图谱提取框架GraphMERT提取的特定疾病知识图谱（胃轻瘫和糖尿病）。针对每个主KG三元组，我们从同一文本片段中提取支持性三元组，形成上下文图（CG）。这产生了两种监督设置：仅使用目标KG三元组或路径的KG基础监督，以及结合目标三元组或路径与支持性上下文三元组的CG基础监督。我们在两种设置下使用监督微调（SFT）训练Qwen3-14B模型，生成KGModel和CGModel变体。为加强模型的低阶事实基础，我们引入一个由LLM判断、历史感知的自适应修复流水线，识别未解决的一跳失败，持续在针对性修复样本上微调，并移除或隔离有问题的噪声三元组。此修复阶段使模型在清理后保留的一跳验证集上达到100%准确率。最后，我们使用低阶问答项进行强化学习（RL），并在更难的3跳、4跳和5跳任务上评估泛化能力。在两种疾病上，上下文增强监督均持续优于仅KG监督。从修复后的SFT检查点初始化的RL带来更大且更稳定的提升。

summary: Comparing and selecting task-oriented LLM agents increasingly relies on a low-cost offline evaluation gate: persona-driven LLM user-simulators converse with each candidate, an LLM-as-a-judge scores the transcripts, and the higher-scoring agent is promoted. We introduce GAUGE, a reusable offline protocol that measures whether this gate's ranking matches a grounded verifiable reward across 25 agents from six providers on the $\tau^2$-bench and SimulatorArena benchmarks, separating two kinds of evaluation validity that release practices conflate: ranking validity and construct validity. First, a satisfaction-success gap: satisfaction carries essentially no information about task success, as conversations rated satisfied by our blind panel are decorrelated from actual success, with 57.5% of them failing the customer's task, a pattern consistent across five rater populations, both benchmarks, and every subjective dimension we rated. Second, while the gate's ranking is robust across the broad capability span, it loses resolution among the near-equal strong agents: this decision-disagreement rate jumps from $<$1% on wide-reward pairs to 31% on close pairs. The gate is thus human-validated yet mis-anchored. As a remedy, we propose a calibrate-then-trust cadence in which a judge-free completion bit is a zero-cost tripwire for truncation regressions.
title: GAUGE: When Not to Trust LLM-as-a-Judge in User-Simulated Evaluation of Task-Oriented Agents
title_translated: GAUGE：在任务导向智能体用户模拟评估中何时不应信任LLM作为评判者
summary_translated: 比较和选择任务导向的LLM智能体越来越多地依赖于低成本离线评估门控机制：以角色驱动的LLM用户模拟器与候选智能体对话，LLM作为评判者对对话记录打分，得分较高的智能体被优先推荐。我们提出了GAUGE，一种可重复使用的离线协议，用于衡量该门控机制的排名是否与25个来自六个提供商的智能体在τ²-bench和SimulatorArena基准上的可验证奖励一致，从而区分两种在发布实践中混淆的评估有效性：排名有效性和构念有效性。首先，存在满意度-成功差距：满意度几乎不携带关于任务成功的任何信息，因为我们的盲评小组评定为满意的对话与实际成功无关，其中57.5%未能完成客户任务，这一模式在五个评分人群、两个基准及所有主观维度上均一致。其次，尽管该门控机制在广泛能力范围内排名稳健，但在接近性能的强智能体之间失去分辨力：决策分歧率从宽奖励对的不到1%跃升至近似对的31%。因此，该门控机制虽经人类验证，却锚定错误。作为补救措施，我们提出‘校准后信任’的节奏，其中无评判者的完成位作为零成本的触发器，用于检测截断退化。

summary: Food access is multidimensional, but population-level measurement still relies heavily on geography because perceived dimensions of access are difficult to measure at scale. Here, we use 25,125 Google Maps reviews from 49 grocery stores in Raleigh, North Carolina, to measure five dimensions of food access: availability, accessibility, affordability, accommodation, and acceptability. We identify review topics with unsupervised topic modeling and assign them to access dimensions using zero-shot classification, with 85.4% agreement against manual coding. The resulting store-level measures capture distinct aspects of food access and reveal barriers that geographic proximity alone does not capture. Comparisons between nearby stores in the same chain further show that identical store policies can be perceived very differently across locations, consistent with food access reflecting the fit between residents and their food environment. Perceived food access also follows systematic socioeconomic and demographic patterns that broadly parallel, but do not replicate, those observed for geographic access. These results show that online grocery reviews can provide a scalable complement to geographic measures of food access.
title: Population-level measures of perceived food access reveal barriers beyond geographic proximity
title_translated: 感知食物可及性的群体水平度量揭示了地理距离之外的障碍
summary_translated: 食物可及性是多维的，但群体水平的测量仍严重依赖地理因素，因为感知维度的规模化测量困难。本文利用北卡罗来纳州罗利市49家杂货店的25,125条Google地图评论，测量食物可及性的五个维度：可得性、可达性、可负担性、适应性和可接受性。我们使用无监督主题建模识别评论主题，并通过零样本分类将其分配到各可及性维度，与人工标注的吻合率达85.4%。由此产生的门店级度量捕捉了食物可及性的不同方面，并揭示了仅靠地理邻近无法体现的障碍。对同一家连锁品牌内相邻门店的比较进一步表明，相同的门店政策在不同地点可能被感知为截然不同，这与食物可及性反映居民与其食物环境匹配度的观点一致。感知食物可及性也呈现出系统性的社会经济与人口统计学模式，总体上与地理可及性相似，但并非完全复制。这些结果表明，在线杂货店评论可为地理测量提供可扩展的补充。

summary: Prompt-policy editing offers a practical way to improve agents that synthesize executable workflows without updating the underlying model. However, persistent prompt editing has two coupled properties. First, edit locality does not imply effect locality: an edit confined to one policy segment can ripple through downstream execution, altering behavior beyond the edited segment. Second, edit effects are composition-sensitive: edits that work in isolation can interfere after composition, causing one or both to lose their benefit or become harmful. Persistent adaptation must therefore support two distinct decisions: identifying where the policy should change from execution feedback, and determining whether the resulting edit remains safe to persist after composition. To address these challenges, we introduce RIPPLE (Replay-Informed Persistent Policy Localization and Editing), which separates where an edit is made from whether it remains safe after composition. It diagnoses failed trajectories, maps each actionable failure to a predefined policy segment, and restricts the correction to that part of the policy. RIPPLE then evaluates candidates against the same iteration-start policy to compare their isolated gains, before replaying promising edits after previously accepted updates to expose downstream effects and interactions. Only edits that remain safe under composition are retained. We evaluate RIPPLE on Flow-HO, a synthetic held-out benchmark for executable workflow synthesis. RIPPLE improves validation success by up to 23.1% and yields positive gains on two additional frozen language-model backbones, while maintaining edit efficiency and low execution cost. Targeted interaction analysis further demonstrates both properties: a segment-local tool-use edit changes downstream resource resolution and validation, while an edit beneficial in isolation becomes harmful after composition.
title: Local Edits, Global Ripples: Replay-Informed Policy Adaptation for Workflow Synthesis
title_translated: 局部修改，全局涟漪：面向工作流合成的回放感知策略自适应
summary_translated: 提示-策略编辑为在不更新底层模型的情况下改进合成可执行工作流的智能体提供了一种实用方法。然而，持续的提示编辑具有两个相互关联的特性。第一，编辑局部性不等于效果局部性：局限于一个策略段的编辑可能在下游执行中产生涟漪效应，改变编辑段以外的行为。第二，编辑效果具有组合敏感性：在孤立状态下有效的编辑在组合后可能发生冲突，导致一个或两个编辑失去效益甚至产生危害。因此，持续适应必须支持两个独立决策：根据执行反馈确定策略应修改的位置，以及判断该编辑在组合后是否仍安全持久。为应对这些挑战，我们提出RIPPLE（回放感知的持续策略定位与编辑），将编辑位置与组合安全性分离。它诊断失败轨迹，将每个可操作失败映射到预定义的策略段，并将修正限制在该策略部分。RIPPLE随后在相同迭代起始策略下评估候选方案，比较其孤立收益，再在先前接受的更新后重播有前景的编辑，以暴露下游影响和交互。只有在组合下仍安全的编辑才被保留。我们在Flow-HO——一个用于可执行工作流合成的合成保留基准——上评估RIPPLE。RIPPLE将验证成功率最高提升23.1%，并在另外两个冻结的语言模型骨干上实现正向增益，同时保持编辑效率和低执行成本。针对性交互分析进一步验证了上述两种特性：局部工具使用编辑改变了下游资源解析和验证，而孤立时有益的编辑在组合后变为有害。

summary: Consonants contribute unequally to whether a word is understood. Given the limited time available for therapy, ranking consonants by contribution to intelligibility helps prioritize intervention targets in motor speech disorders. However, measuring this contribution relies on perceptual studies that are difficult to scale. This paper presents a scalable method that measures consonant contribution using acoustic masking. We silence one consonant at a time in an isolated word and test whether an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model still recognizes the word. We define a consonant's contribution score as the proportion of its masked instances for which the word becomes misrecognized, which we refer to as the mask-induced misrecognition rate (MMR). We validate MMR against two linguistic factors previously reported to correlate with consonant contribution, namely phoneme frequency and functional load. We apply this analysis across four languages, English, Spanish, German, and Czech, using three ASR architectures, MMS (encoder-only), Whisper (encoder-decoder), and Qwen3-ASR (LLM-based). Using partial Spearman correlations, we find that phoneme frequency correlates negatively with MMR while functional load correlates positively. In other words, more frequent consonants are less disruptive when masked, whereas consonants carrying more lexical contrast are more disruptive. Further cross-language analysis shows that consonant rankings are not consistent, indicating that consonant contribution is language-dependent.
title: Quantifying Consonant Contributions to Word Intelligibility via Acoustic Masking
title_translated: 通过声学掩蔽量化辅音对单词可理解性的影响
summary_translated: 辅音对单词是否被理解的贡献程度不一。鉴于治疗时间有限，按辅音对可理解性的贡献程度排序有助于在运动性言语障碍中优先确定干预目标。然而，测量这种贡献依赖于难以扩展的感知研究。本文提出一种可扩展的方法，通过声学掩蔽测量辅音贡献。我们逐次静音孤立单词中的一个辅音，并测试自动语音识别（ASR）模型是否仍能正确识别该单词。我们将辅音的贡献分数定义为在被掩蔽实例中单词被误识别的比例，即掩蔽诱发误识别率（MMR）。我们用此前报告与辅音贡献相关的两个语言学因素——音素频率和功能负荷——验证MMR。我们在四种语言（英语、西班牙语、德语和捷克语）中应用该分析，使用三种ASR架构：MMS（仅编码器）、Whisper（编码器-解码器）和Qwen3-ASR（基于LLM）。通过偏斯皮尔曼相关分析，我们发现音素频率与MMR呈负相关，而功能负荷与MMR呈正相关。换言之，频率越高的辅音被掩蔽时破坏性越小，而承载更多词汇对比的辅音则更具破坏性。跨语言分析进一步表明，辅音排名并不一致，说明辅音贡献具有语言依赖性。

summary: Factual hallucination in closed-book question answering is often treated as a coverage problem: a model fails because the relevant fact is absent from its internal memory. This view misses a second source of error. Even when a fact has been observed, finite memory may force it to be stored only approximately. We study this effect through a simple coverage--compression model of factual recall. We consider an unstructured question-answering task with $N$ possible queries and $K$ possible answers. A learner observes $M$ training facts, compresses them into at most $B$ bits, and answers uniformly drawn test queries without retrieval. For a uniformly random ground-truth mapping, we prove $\mathcal{E} \geq \frac{M}{N}\delta^\star\!\left(\frac{B}{M}\right) + \left(1-\frac{M}{N}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{K}\right)$, where $\delta^\star(r)$ is the inverse rate-distortion function of a uniform $K$-ary source under zero-one loss. The two terms separate compression distortion on observed facts from missing coverage on unobserved facts. The bound gives a compact way to reason about selective memory, forced compression, structure, retrieval, abstention, and long-context organization. We study the predicted signatures with theory-implied simulations and controlled fact-injection probes in modern language models that vary fact load and effective trainable memory. The result is not a complete theory of hallucination, but an information-theoretic account of a separable failure mode: lossy recall of observed facts under finite memory.
title: The Cost of Compression: A Rate-Distortion Limit on Factual Hallucination
title_translated: 压缩的成本：事实幻觉的率失真极限
summary_translated: 封闭书式问答中的事实幻觉通常被视为覆盖问题：模型失败是因为相关事实未存在于其内部记忆中。这一观点忽略了第二种错误来源。即使某个事实已被观察到，有限的记忆也可能迫使其仅以近似方式存储。我们通过一个简单的覆盖-压缩模型来研究这一效应。考虑一个包含 $N$ 个可能查询和 $K$ 个可能答案的非结构化问答任务。学习者观察 $M$ 个训练事实，将它们压缩至最多 $B$ 位，并在不进行检索的情况下回答随机抽取的测试查询。对于一个均匀随机的真实映射，我们证明了 $/mathcal{E} \geq \frac{M}{N}\delta^\star\!\left(\frac{B}{M}\right) + \left(1-\frac{M}{N}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{K}\right)$，其中 $\ eta^\star(r)$ 是在零一损失下均匀 $K$ 元源的逆率失真函数。两项分别分离了对已观测事实的压缩失真与对未观测事实的缺失覆盖。该界提供了一种简洁的方式来分析选择性记忆、强制压缩、结构、检索、回避以及长上下文组织等问题。我们通过理论推导的模拟和受控的事实注入探测，在不同事实负载和有效可训练记忆的现代语言模型中研究了预测特征。结果并非幻觉的完整理论，而是一种可分离的失效模式的信息论解释：在有限记忆下对已观测事实的有损回忆。

summary: Development and humanitarian organizations produce and support surveys, administrative registries, and other data resources to inform research, policy, and operations, yet systematically identifying where these datasets are referenced remains difficult. Such references are dispersed across research papers, project documents, humanitarian reports, and other unstructured text, limiting both the ability to trace data use and to identify potential gaps in data availability or dissemination. We present a weakly supervised framework for adapting dataset extraction to forced displacement and Fragile, Conflict, and Violence (FCV) documents without first constructing a large manually labeled training corpus. A lightweight model trained on general research literature generates candidate dataset mentions from unlabeled domain documents, which a frontier large language model (LLM) reviews in context, validating or rejecting candidates and correcting their extraction boundaries. The resulting annotations are supplemented with targeted synthetic and contrastive examples and used to fine-tune the lightweight model for large-scale extraction. We evaluate the resulting model on an independent gold-standard benchmark of 1,706 text passages spanning research, humanitarian, and operational documents. Across the full benchmark, the model achieves 74.1\% precision and 70.5\% recall at the mention level; among passages containing dataset references, precision reaches 89.5\%. At the passage level, the model achieves 88.2\% accuracy and 88.6\% specificity in distinguishing passages with dataset references from those without them. These results demonstrate a practical approach for constructing domain-specific supervision when labeled data are limited, and provide a technical foundation for larger-scale analysis of data use and potential gaps in the displacement data landscape.
title: Extracting Dataset Mentions in Forced Displacement and FCV Documents: A Weakly Supervised Framework with LLM-Based Label Refinement
title_translated: 在强迫迁移与FCV文档中提取数据集提及：一种基于LLM标签优化的弱监督框架
summary_translated: 发展与人道主义组织生成并支持调查、行政登记册及其他数据资源，以支持研究、政策和行动，但系统性地识别这些数据集在何处被引用仍具挑战性。此类引用分散于研究论文、项目文件、人道主义报告等非结构化文本中，限制了追踪数据使用的能力，并难以发现数据可用性或传播方面的潜在缺口。我们提出一种弱监督框架，无需预先构建大规模人工标注训练语料库，即可将数据集提取适配于强迫迁移和脆弱、冲突与暴力（FCV）文档。一个在通用研究文献上训练的轻量级模型从无标签领域文档中生成候选数据集提及，由前沿大语言模型（LLM）在上下文中审查，验证或拒绝候选项并修正其提取边界。所得标注通过有针对性的合成与对比样例补充，并用于微调轻量级模型以实现大规模提取。我们在一个包含1,706个文本片段的独立黄金标准基准上评估该模型，涵盖研究、人道主义和操作文档。在全基准上，模型在提及级别达到74.1%的精确率和70.5%的召回率；在包含数据集引用的段落中，精确率达到89.5%。在段落级别，模型在区分含数据集引用与不含引用的段落方面达到88.2%的准确率和88.6%的特异性。这些结果展示了在标注数据有限时构建领域特定监督的实用方法，并为更大规模的数据使用分析及迁移数据格局中的潜在缺口提供了技术基础。

summary: Checking Quran recitation from an ASR transcript requires distinguishing unresolved mistakes from repetitions, repairs, opening formulas and accepted spelling differences. We report a completed human annotation of 100 production recording cases: 348 scored units and 162 localized events across ten combined labels. An executable evaluator scores labels and word positions together. A plain diff reaches label-aware F1 0.525 and localization F1 0.826; adapted production cleaner/alignment components reach 0.518 and 0.786, with exact-span F1 0.505 for both. Correcting the adapter's word coordinates recovers all five annotated repetition events, showing why annotation interfaces must be checked before interpreting baseline failures. In a preliminary pilot, eight single 20-minute runs across three coding agents and eight models span label-aware F1 0.143 to 0.892: seven land far above every baseline, and one collapses below the naive diff from a missing normalization step. Across the six, 970 of 972 gold-event instances draw an overlapping prediction, so what remains is not detection but convention: span extent, and the labels whose boundary is stipulated by adjudication rather than visible in the text. Seven of 162 events defeat all six same-day runs, five of them one orthographic rule, and the strongest run still misses the same ones. No run annotated before building, so the pilot measures the algorithm half of the task only.
title: What Counts as a Mistake? Annotating Recitation Events in Quran Memorization Transcripts
title_translated: 什么是错误？对《古兰经》背诵转录中的复述事件进行标注
summary_translated: 从自动语音识别（ASR）转录中检查《古兰经》背诵，需要区分未解决的错误、重复、修复、开场公式和可接受的拼写差异。我们报告了对100个生产录音案例的已完成人工标注：共348个评分单元和162个局部事件，涵盖十个合并标签。一个可执行的评估器同时对标签和词位置进行评分。普通diff方法达到标签感知F1 0.525和定位F1 0.826；经过调整的生产清洗/对齐组件达到0.518和0.786，两者精确跨度F1均为0.505。纠正适配器的词坐标后恢复了所有五个标注的重复事件，说明标注界面必须在解释基线失败前进行验证。在初步试点中，八次单次20分钟运行跨越三个编码代理和八个模型，标签感知F1范围为0.143至0.892：七次远高于所有基线，一次因缺少归一化步骤而低于朴素diff。在六次运行中，970个金标事件中有972个产生重叠预测，因此剩余问题并非检测，而是约定：跨度范围，以及由裁决而非文本可见性决定边界的标签。162个事件中有七个在六次同日运行中均未被正确标注，其中五个源于一个正字法规则，最强运行仍遗漏相同事件。所有运行均在构建前完成标注，因此试点仅衡量算法部分的任务。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used for automated fact checking, but end-to-end prompting often entangles evidence retrieval, reasoning, and uncertainty estimation, making failures difficult to diagnose and confidence difficult to trust. We present R2VC, a modular retrieve, reason, verify, calibrate architecture for evidence-grounded fact checking with citations and abstention. R2VC combines hybrid sparse+dense retrieval over Wikipedia, a supervised fine-tuned and DPO-aligned generator that produces diverse structured verdict candidates, an external NLI cross-encoder for evidence-based candidate selection, and a lightweight sequence-level calibrator for confidence estimation and selective abstention. On FEVER, an 8B backbone with R2VC achieves 13.74% higher accuracy than baseline. Ablation studies show that verifier-based candidate selection and confidence calibration are the largest contributors to performance. Removing candidate selection drops FEVER accuracy to 76.24%, while removing calibration nearly doubles the Brier score to 0.161. A manual analysis of 250 errors further shows that retrieval failures, especially wrong-entity evidence, remain the dominant bottleneck. Together, these results show that modular fact-checking pipelines can substantially improve both predictive accuracy and confidence reliability in open-domain verification.
title: R2VC: Modular Fact-Checking with Retrieval, Verification, and Confidence Calibration
title_translated: R2VC：基于检索、验证与置信度校准的模块化事实核查
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于自动化事实核查，但端到端提示往往将证据检索、推理和不确定性估计纠缠在一起，导致故障难以诊断且置信度难以信赖。我们提出R2VC，一种模块化的检索、推理、验证、校准架构，用于基于证据的事实核查，支持引用和回避。R2VC结合了维基百科上的混合稀疏+密集检索、经过监督微调和DPO对齐的生成器（生成多样化的结构化结论候选）、用于基于证据的候选选择的外部NLI交叉编码器，以及用于置信度估计和选择性回避的轻量级序列级校准器。在FEVER基准上，采用8B主干模型的R2VC比基线高出13.74%的准确率。消融研究显示，验证器驱动的候选选择和置信度校准是性能提升的主要贡献者。移除候选选择使FEVER准确率降至76.24%，而移除校准几乎使Brier得分翻倍至0.161。对250个错误的手动分析进一步表明，检索失败（尤其是错误实体的证据）仍是主要瓶颈。综合来看，这些结果表明模块化事实核查流程能显著提高开放域验证中的预测准确性和置信度可靠性。

summary: Conversational voice agents have advanced significantly, offering increasingly natural human-machine interactions through both cascaded and end-to-end architectures. However, while recent benchmarks extensively evaluate dyadic interactions and passive audio comprehension, they largely overlook a prevalent real-world scenario: multi-party conversations. Evaluating agents in these settings is fundamentally more challenging than in dyadic interactions due to the exponentially greater conversational complexity. For voice agents to integrate seamlessly into human group dynamics, they must not only generate contextually appropriate responses but also demonstrate a nuanced understanding of open turn-taking. To address this gap, we introduce Multiparty Bench (MP-Bench), the first benchmark specifically designed to objectively evaluate conversational speech systems as active participants within multi-party contexts. MP-Bench assesses agent behavior along two primary dimensions: turn-taking awareness and response appropriateness. Additionally, we incorporate comprehension-based question-answering tasks as a complementary evaluation. By benchmarking 12 voice agents, we find that real-time voice agents stay at or below 22% on multiparty comprehension and remain near chance on multiparty turn-taking, exposing an open challenge for real-time voice agents under multiparty scenario.
title: MP-Bench: Evaluating Voice Agents as a Multiparty Conversation Participant
title_translated: MP-Bench：评估语音智能体作为多参与者对话者的角色
summary_translated: 对话式语音智能体已取得显著进展，通过级联和端到端架构实现了日益自然的人机交互。然而，尽管近期基准广泛评估双人互动和被动音频理解，却大多忽视了现实世界中普遍存在的场景：多人对话。在这些情境下评估智能体比双人互动更具根本挑战性，因为对话复杂性呈指数级增长。为了让语音智能体无缝融入人类群体动态，它们不仅需要生成合乎语境的回应，还需展现出对开放式轮流发言的细致理解。为填补这一空白，我们引入了Multiparty Bench（MP-Bench），首个专门设计用于客观评估对话语音系统作为多参与者对话中主动成员的基准。MP-Bench从两个主要维度评估智能体行为：轮流发言意识和回应适当性。此外，我们还引入基于理解的问答任务作为补充评估。通过对12个语音智能体的基准测试，我们发现实时语音智能体在多人理解任务上的表现不超过22%，在多人轮流发言任务上接近随机水平，揭示了实时语音智能体在多人场景下面临的开放挑战。

summary: Fine-grained control of language model behaviors (e.g., steering) is among the more actionable outcomes of interpretability research. For binary concepts such as refusal, a single direction in activation space often suffices for steering. However, many concepts are not binary: Animals and Countries contain many subcategories, each with multiple instances. For these concepts, the search space over possible representation geometries is far larger than for binary concepts; it is thus not clear what geometries are most appropriate, nor what methods are most effective at recovering them. In this work, we introduce MAxBench, a geometry-agnostic evaluation framework for multinomial concept representations based on sampling from the recovered concept representation. We use MAxBench to compare 10 localization methods (covering 5 geometry types) across 6 concepts and 4 models. Using this framework, we find that (i) affine subspaces steer more reliably and have greater recall than rank-one or linear subspaces; (ii) much of this advantage is due to better non-zero offsets rather than the choice of bases; (iii) manifold steering is competitive with the best methods when applicable; and (iv) no method consistently outperforms prompting, in alignment with prior findings on binary concepts. These findings underscore the importance of expanding the scope of interpretability research and meta-evaluation to concepts with more varied structure.
title: MAxBench: A Multinomial Concept Recovery Benchmark
title_translated: MAxBench：一种多类别概念恢复基准测试
summary_translated: 语言模型行为的细粒度控制（例如方向引导）是可解释性研究中最具实际意义的成果之一。对于二元概念（如拒绝），激活空间中的单一方向通常足以实现引导。然而，许多概念并非二元：动物和国家包含多个子类别，每个子类别又有多个实例。对于这些概念，可能的表示几何结构搜索空间远大于二元概念；因此，尚不清楚哪种几何结构最合适，以及哪种方法最有效于恢复它们。本文提出MAxBench，一种基于从恢复的概念表示中采样的、与几何无关的多类别概念表示评估框架。我们使用MAxBench在6个概念和4个模型上比较了10种定位方法（涵盖5种几何类型）。通过该框架，我们发现：(i) 仿射子空间比秩一或线性子空间更可靠且召回率更高；(ii) 这一优势主要源于更好的非零偏移而非基的选择；(iii) 当适用时，流形引导与最佳方法具有竞争力；(iv) 没有任何方法在所有情况下都优于提示法，这与先前关于二元概念的研究结果一致。这些发现强调了将可解释性研究和元评估范围扩展到结构更复杂的概念的重要性。

summary: We investigate the effect of pretrained T5 model scale and explicit motion features on pose-to-text Indian Sign Language Translation (SLT) for the WSLP 2026 Shared Task. Pose sequences are projected into the embedding space of T5 through a lightweight pose encoder, with the complete model fine-tuned to generate English text. The shared task data used for this work consists of a test set with 5,334 examples and a validation set with 5,257 examples. We compare T5-small, T5-base, and T5-large, and additionally introduce a motion-augmented variant, T5-small + Motion, that adds explicit frame-to-frame pose differences to the input representation. T5-small achieves the best BLEU and ROUGE scores among the spatial-only models, while T5-large obtains the highest chrF score. Augmenting T5-small with motion features yields the largest single improvement observed in our study, substantially improving BLEU over the spatial-only baseline and making it the strongest model overall on this metric. Our submitted system ranked 5th on the official WSLP 2026 SLT testing leaderboard. The source code and trained models are publicly available on GitHub and HuggingFace.
title: Investigating Temporal Motion Features for Pose-to-Text Indian Sign Language Translation
title_translated: 探究时间运动特征在手语翻译中的应用：面向印度手语的姿势转文本任务
summary_translated: 我们研究了预训练T5模型规模和显式运动特征对WSLP 2026共享任务中姿势转文本印度手语翻译（SLT）的影响。姿态序列通过轻量级姿态编码器投影到T5的嵌入空间中，整个模型经过微调以生成英文文本。本研究使用的共享任务数据包括5,334个测试样本和5,257个验证样本。我们对比了T5-small、T5-base和T5-large，并额外引入一种运动增强变体T5-small + Motion，该变体在输入表示中加入帧间姿态差异的显式信息。在仅使用空间信息的模型中，T5-small取得了最佳BLEU和ROUGE得分；而T5-large则获得了最高的chrF得分。将运动特征增强至T5-small带来了研究中最大的单次提升，显著提高了BLEU得分，使其在该指标上成为最强模型。我们提交的系统在官方WSLP 2026 SLT测试排行榜中位列第5。源代码和训练好的模型已公开发布于GitHub和HuggingFace。

summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) is conventionally scored by exact-match rates and string-similarity metrics that are blind to where an error occurs: two predictions with identical token-error counts receive identical scores whether they misplace a subscript or swap the operands of a fraction. Render-based character detection matching (CDM) aligns glyphs robustly but remains position-blind---on controlled fraction-operand swaps it scores 0.8595 where position-aware scoring yields 0.6253. Tree-edit metrics exhibit a complementary blind spot: rewrites outside the parser's normalization coverage are penalized as structural errors (0.8552 where render-based metrics score 1.0). We propose PA-CDM, a position-aware metric that couples character detection matching with position-forest encoding and divergence-level weighting; StructPerturb v2.0, a frozen benchmark of 1,340 controlled perturbation pairs across 15 type--intensity cells; and a cross-metric consistency protocol combining a sensitivity matrix, a human study, and LLM-judge calibration. In a six-annotator study, PA-CDM attains the highest correlation with human judgments among seven automatic metrics (Spearman rho=0.9535, n=990). A frontier LLM judge correlates slightly higher (rho=0.9613) but is costly, nondeterministic, and API-dependent; PA-CDM approaches it at zero marginal cost with deterministic, diagnosable behavior.
title: PA-CDM: Position-Aware Character Detection Matching for Evaluating Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
title_translated: PA-CDM：用于手写数学表达式识别评估的位置感知字符检测匹配方法
summary_translated: 手写数学表达式识别（HMER）传统上采用精确匹配率和字符串相似度指标进行评分，但这些指标对错误发生位置不敏感：两个预测的标记错误数相同，无论其错误是下标错位还是分数操作数互换，得分都相同。基于渲染的字符检测匹配（CDM）虽能稳健对齐字形，但仍忽略位置信息——在受控的分数操作数交换场景中，其得分为0.8595，而位置感知评分仅为0.6253。树编辑度量存在互补盲点：超出解析器归一化覆盖范围的重写被惩罚为结构性错误（得分为0.8552，而基于渲染的度量得分为1.0）。我们提出PA-CDM，一种结合字符检测匹配与位置森林编码及分歧级别加权的位置感知度量；StructPerturb v2.0，一个包含1,340对受控扰动的冻结基准数据集，覆盖15种类型-强度单元；以及一种跨度量一致性协议，结合敏感性矩阵、人工评估和LLM裁判校准。在六名标注员的研究中，PA-CDM在七种自动度量中与人类判断的相关性最高（Spearman rho=0.9535，n=990）。前沿LLM裁判相关性略高（rho=0.9613），但成本高、非确定性且依赖API；PA-CDM以零边际成本实现类似表现，具备确定性和可诊断行为。

summary: Agentic pipelines for structured-query generation are rapidly expanding, but it is unclear which part of the loop produces the gain. We use LAST-CQ -- a five-agent, training-free, execution-grounded Text-to-Cypher framework -- as an instrumented testbed, running three counterfactuals over 2,471 live-database queries and six backbones spanning three vendor scale tiers. Removing correction is worth between 3.1% aggregate execution-BLEU against the single-pass system and 12.3% against a no-refinement counterfactual (up to 80.7% for the weakest backbone). Replacing schema-grounded, LLM-synthesised feedback with raw database error strings costs almost nothing (20.9% vs. 19.9% naive exact match; <0.2% end-to-end; equivalent within $\pm 0.075$ set-F1 by two one-sided tests). Spending the same call budget on parallel sampling degrades quality by 10-11%. What works is detecting failure and routing it to a retry, not the feedback sophistication or number of samples. LAST-CQ itself recovers 91.7% of queries that fail under single-pass generation, while a query that succeeds first time still costs exactly one LLM call. We also show that n-gram overlap on serialised results is not a bound in either direction: it over-scores against set equivalence on 65.9% of results while under-scoring against judged semantics. Finally, we calibrate our LLM judge against blind human labels and find it optimistic by 9 points.
title: What Drives Recovery in Agentic Text-to-Cypher? LAST-CQ: An LLM Agent Self-Refinement Framework
comment: Accepted at REALM: The 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models at Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026), 15 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
title_translated: 驱动智能体文本转Cypher中恢复能力的关键因素：LAST-CQ——一种大语言模型智能体自修正框架
summary_translated: 结构化查询生成的智能体流水线迅速发展，但尚不清楚循环中的哪个环节带来了性能提升。我们使用LAST-CQ——一种五智能体、无需训练、基于执行的文本转Cypher框架——作为仪器化测试平台，在2,471个真实数据库查询和六个跨越三个厂商规模层级的骨干模型上运行三种反事实实验。移除修正机制带来的收益在整体执行BLEU上相当于单次通过系统的3.1%，在无修正反事实对比中达到12.3%（最弱骨干模型高达80.7%）。将基于模式的LLM合成反馈替换为原始数据库错误字符串几乎不造成损失（朴素精确匹配：20.9% vs. 19.9%；端到端：<0.2%；在两组单边检验中set-F1差异在±0.075范围内等价）。在相同调用预算下进行并行采样反而使质量下降10-11%。真正有效的是检测失败并将其路由至重试，而非反馈复杂度或采样数量。LAST-CQ本身能够恢复单次生成失败的91.7%查询，而首次成功查询仍需恰好一次LLM调用。我们还证明，序列化结果的n-gram重叠并非集合等价性的上下界：它在65.9%的结果中对集合等价过度评分，而在语义判断中又出现低估。最后，我们将LLM裁判与盲人人工标签校准，发现其乐观程度高出9分。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) process long contexts, including long documents and lengthy conversations, but face token-level memory usage that increases proportionally to input length. Although model optimization and lossy prompt compression are widely used, these methods still fail to solve the long-context recall problem beyond pretrained and size-constrained context windows. This paper proposes a long-context recall method that maintains near-constant GPU memory usage as context length increases, without additional training. The main idea is to reconstruct facts using parameter activations in the LLM's feed-forward layers, which store residual vectors representing facts from the source document. Utilizing residual vectors allows the LLM to deterministically reconstruct query relevant facts without referencing the original document, preserving high fidelity and reducing memory usage without fine-tuning weights. Experimental results show that the proposed method enables answering single-fact questions in two-million-token story contexts where previous methods fail.
title: Residual Vector-based Reconstruction as Long-Context Recall Regardless of Context Window Size
title_translated: 基于残差向量的重建：无论上下文窗口大小均可实现长上下文回忆
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够处理长上下文，包括长文档和长时间对话，但面临随输入长度增加而呈比例增长的令牌级内存使用问题。尽管模型优化和有损提示压缩广泛应用，这些方法仍无法解决超出预训练和尺寸受限上下文窗口的长上下文回忆问题。本文提出一种长上下文回忆方法，可在上下文长度增加时保持近似恒定的GPU内存使用，且无需额外训练。核心思想是利用LLM前馈层中的参数激活来重构事实，这些激活存储了来自源文档的事实残差向量。利用残差向量使LLM能够确定性地重构与查询相关的事实，而无需参考原始文档，从而在不微调权重的情况下保持高保真度并降低内存使用。实验结果表明，该方法使得在两百万令牌的故事上下文中回答单事实问题成为可能，而此前的方法在此类场景下均告失败。

summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models support low-latency turn taking, interruption handling, and backchanneling, yet a key capability remains underexplored: steerability, the ability to reliably shift conversational behavior along attributes such as tone, persona, speaking rate, and voice style in response to user instructions. We introduce a taxonomy of text- and audio-based steerability that identifies substantial gaps in current full-duplex models. To address this gap, we introduce SteerDuplex, a Moshi-based full-duplex speech model fine-tuned on natural conversations and synthetic dialogues targeting instruction following, vocal delivery, reasoning, and duplex interaction. We further apply two-stage reinforcement learning (RL) with hybrid rewards, combining verifiable interaction checks and judge-based semantic feedback to improve timing and response continuity. To evaluate full-duplex spoken steerability, we introduce SteerBench, a benchmark with 390 spoken prompts and 1,067 human-authored binary audio and text rubrics spanning tone, persona, style/accent, and speed/length. On SteerBench, supervised training improves audio-steering average pass rate by 44.5 percentage points over the strongest evaluated open baseline. On Audio MultiChallenge, task average pass rate improves by 7 points over its strongest evaluated open baseline. RL further raises source-clean interruption response from 72.5% to 82.5% and reduces synthetic pause barge-in from 26.5% to 9%. Steering and aggregate task scores remain comparable or higher, while reward probes reveal reward hacking through incomplete responses. Our model and benchmark support systematic research on spoken steerability, with reward analysis showing why timing gains must be evaluated alongside response completeness.
title: SteerDuplex: Steerable Duplex Speech Dialogue Models
title_translated: SteerDuplex：可调节的双工语音对话模型
summary_translated: 全双工语音对话模型支持低延迟的轮次切换、打断处理和反馈回应，但一个关键能力仍缺乏深入研究：可调节性，即根据用户指令可靠地调整对话行为（如语调、角色、说话速度和语音风格）的能力。我们提出了一种基于文本和音频的可调节性分类体系，揭示了当前全双工模型中的显著差距。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了SteerDuplex，这是一个基于Moshi架构的全双工语音模型，通过自然对话和合成对话数据进行微调，专注于指令遵循、语音表达、推理能力和双工交互。我们进一步采用两阶段强化学习（RL），结合可验证的交互检查与基于评判的语义反馈，以提升响应时机和连续性。为评估全双工语音可调节性，我们引入SteerBench基准测试，包含390个语音提示和1,067个由人类编写的二元音频与文本标注，涵盖语调、角色、风格/口音以及速度/长度等维度。在SteerBench上，监督训练使音频调节平均通过率比最强的开源基线高出44.5个百分点；在Audio MultiChallenge上，任务平均通过率提升7个百分点。强化学习进一步将源清晰打断响应率从72.5%提升至82.5%，并将合成停顿打断率从26.5%降至9%。调节性能与综合任务得分保持相当或更高水平，但奖励探测显示存在通过不完整响应实现奖励欺骗的现象。我们的模型与基准测试支持对语音可调节性的系统性研究，奖励分析表明，时机提升必须与响应完整性一同评估。

summary: Real-world Earth observation (EO) agents must translate high-level scientific questions into executable workflows to acquire observations, prepare data, perform domain computations, and derive conclusions from runtime evidence. Existing EO agents typically start from supplied observations, while benchmarks typically provide prepared inputs or candidate answers, leaving full-chain open-world EO execution largely untested. We present Earth-Agent-Pro, an execution-adaptive Plan-and-Execute framework using expert-authored skills to constrain planning and runtime tool use. Workflow-centered structured memory records planned steps, accepted evidence, and their dependencies, enabling repair of only the affected workflow suffix when runtime evidence invalidates a step. Separate large language model adapters use sequence-level supervised fine-tuning for planner workflow composition and node-level group relative policy optimization with locally verifiable rewards for executor tool-argument grounding. Earth-Bench-Pro instantiates 248 expert-curated task cores as 744 questions under three matched regimes. Its 248 Open-World Execution questions span RGB imagery, spectral observations, and remote sensing products, pairing high-level requests with runtime data requirements, executable trajectories, and open-ended answers grounded in execution evidence. With a shared GPT-5 backbone, Earth-Agent-Pro achieves 66.13% LLM-as-Judge accuracy, exceeding ReAct by 20.95 points in this metric and 24.44 points in Tools-In-Order. Joint adapter tuning raises Qwen3.5-9B LLM-as-Judge accuracy from 38.31% to 50.00%, an 11.69-point gain over the untuned configuration. Planning-only evaluation and execution with the reference workflow show that the adapters improve workflow composition and argument grounding, respectively. Code and datasets will be released soon.
title: Earth-Agent-Pro: Towards Real-World Full-Chain Earth Observation with Agents

title_translated: Earth-Agent-Pro：迈向真实世界全流程地球观测的智能体
summary_translated: 真实世界的地球观测（EO）智能体必须将高层次的科学问题转化为可执行的工作流，以获取观测数据、准备数据、执行领域计算，并基于运行时证据得出结论。现有的EO智能体通常从已提供的观测数据开始，而基准测试也多提供预处理输入或候选答案，导致全流程开放世界EO执行尚未得到充分检验。我们提出Earth-Agent-Pro，一种执行自适应的Plan-and-Execute框架，利用专家编写的技能来约束规划和运行时工具使用。以工作流为中心的结构化记忆记录计划步骤、接受的证据及其依赖关系，使得当运行时证据使某一步失效时，仅需修复受影响的工作流后缀。独立的大语言模型适配器分别采用序列级监督微调来构建规划工作流，以及节点级组相对策略优化，结合局部可验证奖励来实现执行器工具参数的精准定位。Earth-Bench-Pro将248个专家精心设计的任务核心实例化为744个问题，涵盖三种匹配场景。其248个开放世界执行问题涉及RGB影像、光谱观测和遥感产品，将高层请求与运行时数据需求、可执行轨迹及基于执行证据的开放式答案相匹配。使用共享的GPT-5骨干模型，Earth-Agent-Pro在LLM-as-Judge指标上达到66.13%准确率，较ReAct高出20.95分，在Tools-In-Order上高出24.44分。联合适配器调优使Qwen3.5-9B在LLM-as-Judge上的准确率从38.31%提升至50.00%，相比未调优配置提高11.69分。仅规划评估与参考工作流执行表明，适配器分别提升了工作流组合与参数定位能力。代码与数据集即将发布。

summary: Large language models are being organized into multi-agent systems with specialized roles, but whether such specialization produces distinct forecasts and whether subsequent synthesis improves utility remains unclear. In this study, we carried out a live, prospective evaluation over the final 56 matches of the information-dense 2026 FIFA World Cup, keeping a frontier foundation model constant while assigning two primary forecasting agents contrasting specialist roles: a quantitative specialist focusing on structured performance statistics and a news specialist focusing on current injuries, tactics and information from press conferences. Their forecasts were then reviewed by a separate critic before being combined by a meta-agent, resulting in a sequential four-agent model. Forecasts from the betting market served as an external benchmark. The news specialist obtained the highest mean probability-weighted Top-3 utility and matched the betting market in Top-3 exact-score hits. Nevertheless, the two specialist forecasters agreed on at least two of the three scorelines in 50 out of 56 matches, and the meta-agent never generated more than one scoreline outside the specialists' forecast set. These findings show that rapidly changing, unstructured information can provide a valuable forecasting signal alongside structured statistics, whereas adding critic and meta-agent stages does not necessarily create complementary information or improve on the strongest specialist.
title: Information Specialization and Constrained Synthesis in Multi-Agent LLM Forecasting: A Prospective Live-Study of the 2026 FIFA World Cup
title_translated: 多智能体大语言模型预测中的信息专业化与受限合成：2026年世界杯前瞻性现场研究
summary_translated: 大型语言模型正被组织成具有专门角色的多智能体系统，但这种专业化是否产生不同的预测结果，以及后续合成是否能提升实用性仍不明确。本研究对信息密集的2026年世界杯最后56场比赛进行了前瞻性实时评估，保持前沿基础模型不变，分配两个主要预测智能体承担对比性专业角色：一名侧重结构化表现统计数据的量化专家，另一名侧重当前伤病、战术及新闻发布会信息的新闻专家。他们的预测随后由独立的评论智能体审查，并由元智能体整合，形成一个四阶段顺序式多智能体模型。博彩市场预测作为外部基准。新闻专家在概率加权Top-3效用方面取得最高均值，并在Top-3精确比分命中率上与博彩市场持平。然而，两名专家在56场比赛中有50场至少对三个比分中的两个达成一致，且元智能体从未生成超过专家预测集合之外的超过一个比分。这些发现表明，快速变化的非结构化信息可与结构化统计数据共同提供有价值的预测信号，而增加评论与元智能体阶段并不必然带来互补信息或超越最强专家的表现。

summary: Test case synthesis is crucial for evaluating and ranking programs generated by large language models (LLMs). However, constructing high-quality test cases remains challenging because reliable expected outputs are often difficult to obtain. We propose Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation (CoTT), which first uses an efficient inductive procedure and invokes transductive generation only when inductive confidence is low. This adaptive design improves output reliability while allocating extra computation only when needed. On code reranking benchmarks, CoTT outperforms prior baselines across the reported metrics while reducing cost relative to applying transductive generation to every input. These results show that confidence-based allocation of test-time computation provides a favorable efficiency-effectiveness trade-off with a single efficient LLM.
title: Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation for Code Reranking
title_translated: 置信度门控的归纳式测试生成用于代码重排序
summary_translated: 测试用例合成对于评估和排序大语言模型（LLMs）生成的程序至关重要。然而，由于可靠的预期输出往往难以获得，构建高质量测试用例仍具挑战性。我们提出置信度门控的归纳式测试生成（CoTT），首先使用高效的归纳方法，仅在归纳置信度较低时才调用归纳式生成。这种自适应设计在提升输出可靠性的同时，仅在必要时分配额外计算资源。在代码重排序基准测试中，CoTT在报告指标上优于先前基线，同时相对于对每个输入都应用归纳式生成的方法降低了成本。结果表明，基于置信度的测试期计算分配在效率与效果之间提供了有利的权衡，仅使用单一高效LLM即可实现。

summary: Social-deduction games such as Werewolf are increasingly used to evaluate LLM agents, but existing evaluations often rely on final game outcomes. We propose a belief-shift evaluation benchmark in Werewolf for analyzing communication skills through belief updating. Using LLM-played games, we annotate suspicion and accusation messages and measure how an observing village-side model's beliefs change after each message. We evaluate 40 open-weight LLM configurations on 1,224 annotated messages. Our results show that larger models better distinguish true wolves from villagers based on game history, but accusations still strongly influence their beliefs. Models become more suspicious of the accused target and less suspicious of the accuser, especially when the accuser is trusted, even if the accuser is wolf-aligned. Larger models better resist accusations from accusers they already distrust. Overall, our findings suggest that current open-weight LLMs up to 120B parameters still struggle to integrate accusation content with source trust in strategic communication. Our benchmark and code are available at this https URL .
title: Do LLMs Trust the Accuser or the Accusation? Measuring Belief Shifts in Werewolf

title_translated: 大语言模型是信任指控者还是指控内容？在狼人杀游戏中测量信念转变
summary_translated: 社交推理游戏如狼人杀正越来越多地被用于评估大语言模型智能体，但现有评估通常依赖于最终游戏结果。我们提出一种狼人杀中的信念转变评估基准，通过信念更新分析沟通能力。利用LLM参与的游戏，我们对怀疑与指控消息进行标注，并测量观察方村庄侧模型在每条消息后信念的变化。我们在1,224条标注消息上评估了40种开源权重LLM配置。结果显示，更大的模型能更好地根据游戏历史区分真正的狼人与村民，但指控仍强烈影响其信念。模型对被指控目标变得更加怀疑，对指控者则减少怀疑，尤其当指控者被信任时，即使该指控者属于狼人阵营。更大的模型更能抵抗来自已有不信任对象的指控。总体而言，我们的发现表明，当前最大达120B参数的开源LLM在战略沟通中仍难以将指控内容与其来源可信度有效融合。我们的基准与代码可在该链接处获取。

summary: Simulated societies of large language model agents are used to study online polarization, and separately to study collective intelligence, but the two are rarely measured in the same system. It is therefore difficult to say whether a society's personality composition shapes both, or whether reducing polarization costs collective competence. We present TraitMix, an experimental design in which the Big Five composition of a simulated social network, both trait levels and trait heterogeneity, is a controlled experimental variable, and in which polarization and collective performance are measured in the same runs. Across 991 simulations of hundred-agent societies, spanning six contested topics and six language models, trait heterogeneity has the largest measured effects, acting in opposite directions on two faces of polarization: varied societies hold more dispersed opinions while being less segregated into camps, so homogeneous societies are not moderate but consensual echo chambers. Trait effects are not additive, as Agreeableness determines the sign of Openness, an interaction that replicates across models although the primary model's estimate is influence-driven. Contrary to the trade-off the study was designed to measure, no polarization measure predicts poorer collective performance, and cross-cutting interaction is the only one of four whose association with collective accuracy survives partialling on the aggregation identity. We report ablations removing two potential measurement circularities, an induction gate applied to every model, and the measures that failed them.
title: Diverse Minds, Divided Networks? Personality Composition, Polarization, and Collective Intelligence in LLM-Based Social Simulations
title_translated: 多样心智，分裂网络？基于大语言模型的社会模拟中人格构成、极化与集体智能的关系
summary_translated: 使用大语言模型代理模拟社会以研究在线极化，或单独研究集体智能，但两者很少在同一系统中被共同测量。因此难以判断社会的人格构成是否同时影响二者，或减少极化是否会损害集体能力。我们提出TraitMix实验设计，其中模拟社交网络的五大性格特质水平和异质性作为受控变量，并在同一运行中测量极化与集体表现。在涵盖六个争议话题和六种语言模型的991次百代理社会模拟中，性格异质性产生了最大的可测量效应，对极化的两个方面产生相反影响：多样化社会持有更分散的观点，同时较少形成阵营对立；而同质社会并非温和，而是共识回音室。性格效应并非线性叠加，宜人性决定了开放性的符号方向，这一交互在不同模型间重复出现，尽管主要模型的估计结果受影响力驱动。与研究设计所预期的权衡相反，没有任何极化指标能预测较差的集体表现，只有四种交叉互动中的一种在控制聚合身份后仍与集体准确性相关。我们报告了移除两个潜在测量循环性的消融实验，对每个模型应用的归纳门控机制，以及未通过测试的度量方法。

summary: Cognitive Diagnosis Models (CDMs) play a pivotal role in personalized online learning. Traditional CDMs rely on discrete, ID-based embeddings to represent students, exercises, and concepts. This paradigm diverges from the nature of learner cognition, where knowledge is not stored and retrieved as isolated symbols. As a result, CDMs suffer from semantic limitations when new exercises or concepts appear. In this paper, we propose a Process-aware Language Cognitive Diagnosis (PLCD) framework that uses language-derived structures as cognitive priors and response records to calibrate student posterior states. PLCD leverages large language models (LLMs) to construct concept schemas and cognitive process graphs, and uses target-conditioned semantic memory to retrieve historical responses that are relevant to each target exercise. A process-grounded Language-to-Cognition Mapper with DA-MoE experts and process-level contrastive learning then maps the textual evidence into a unified cognitive space. Experimental results show that PLCD not only outperforms traditional baselines in predicting student performance but also exhibits strong cognitive transfer capabilities. These results connect the computational power of LLMs with the psychometric goal of measuring latent knowledge states, suggesting that structured language priors calibrated by response records can improve cold-start robustness and cognitive grounding.
title: Beyond ID Embeddings: Process-Grounded Language Modeling for Cognitive Diagnosis

title_translated: 超越ID嵌入：基于过程的语言建模用于认知诊断
summary_translated: 认知诊断模型（CDMs）在个性化在线学习中起关键作用。传统CDMs依赖离散的基于ID的嵌入来表示学生、练习题和概念。这一范式偏离了学习者认知的本质，因为知识并非以孤立符号形式存储和检索。因此，当出现新练习题或概念时，CDMs会遭遇语义局限。本文提出一种过程感知的语言认知诊断（PLCD）框架，利用语言衍生结构作为认知先验，并结合响应记录校准学生的后验状态。PLCD利用大语言模型（LLMs）构建概念图谱和认知过程图，使用目标条件化的语义记忆检索与每个目标练习题相关的过往响应。一个基于过程的语言-认知映射器，结合DA-MoE专家和过程级对比学习，将文本证据映射到统一的认知空间。实验结果表明，PLCD不仅在预测学生表现方面优于传统基线，还展现出强大的认知迁移能力。这些结果将LLM的计算能力与心理测量学中测量潜在知识状态的目标相连接，表明由响应记录校准的结构化语言先验可以提升冷启动鲁棒性和认知根基性。

summary: Draft-verify-revise is a common LLM orchestration pattern for scaling inference-time compute. One LLM drafts, a second critiques the draft and provides feedback, and a third uses that feedback to revise the draft into the final output. As context cascades between stages, LLMs at different stages can resolve a context-dependent expression such as "previous" differently. When that happens, the expression undergoes a deictic shift, a change in what it refers to. This phenomenon was studied with a synthetic dataset of 10 base examples, each rendered in three conditions. Holding the shared components constant, the conditions varied whether the draft stage LLM (the assistant) or the verify stage LLM (the grader) resolved the expression correctly, and how much independent reasoning the revise stage LLM (the meta-evaluator) needed to determine which reading was correct. Six models from three providers were tested across 21 reasoning effort configurations using e-values for sequential testing, in a primary experiment and an ablation experiment that removed error classification labels from the grader's feedback. A separate LLM analyzed the meta-evaluator's stated rationale for each wrong verdict. Balanced accuracy (the unweighted mean of sensitivity and specificity) ranged from 0.156, below chance, to near-perfect. GPT-5.2 rose from 0.156 without reasoning to 0.942 at its highest reasoning effort level, while Gemini 3 Pro stayed above 0.94 at every level. Gemini 3 Pro at low reasoning effort outscored GPT-5.2 at xhigh reasoning effort for roughly 5% of the cost per trial. When the meta-evaluator erred, it tended to rely on surface cues rather than operational reasoning. Context engineers implementing draft-verify-revise pipelines should be wary of deictic shifts and make the intended referent explicit at each stage.
title: Can LLMs in Draft-Verify-Revise Pipelines Resolve Deictic Ambiguity?

title_translated: 大语言模型在草稿-验证-修订流水线中能否解决指示性歧义？
summary_translated: 草稿-验证-修订是一种常见的大语言模型编排模式，用于扩展推理时计算资源。一个LLM生成草稿，第二个模型批判草稿并提供反馈，第三个模型利用该反馈修订草稿为最终输出。随着上下文在各阶段间传递，不同阶段的LLM可能对上下文依赖表达如“之前”做出不同解释。当这种情况发生时，表达会发生指示性转移，即其所指对象发生变化。本研究使用包含10个基础示例的合成数据集进行分析，每个示例在三种条件下呈现。保持共享组件不变，条件变化在于草稿阶段LLM（助手）或验证阶段LLM（评分员）是否正确解析该表达，以及修订阶段LLM（元评估者）需要多少独立推理才能确定正确解读。在21种推理努力配置下，测试了来自三个提供商的六种模型，采用e值进行序列检验，包括主实验和移除评分员反馈中错误分类标签的消融实验。另一LLM分析了元评估者对每次错误判决所陈述的理由。平衡准确率（敏感性和特异性未加权平均）从0.156（低于随机水平）到接近完美不等。GPT-5.2从无推理时的0.156提升至最高推理水平下的0.942，而Gemini 3 Pro在所有水平上均保持在0.94以上。Gemini 3 Pro在低推理成本下表现优于GPT-5.2在高推理成本下的表现，且每轮试验成本仅为其约5%。当元评估者出错时，其往往依赖表面线索而非操作性推理。实施草稿-验证-修订流水线的上下文工程师应警惕指示性转移，并在每个阶段明确意图指代。

summary: Assistants built on large language models are expected to write as their user would, and the dominant approach is single-channel: preferences summarised from conversation history and reinserted into context. This inverts the order of inference. Preferences are the task-dependent surface of a comparatively stable personality structure, so a system storing only preferences relearns the person whenever the task changes. First, we characterise personality seepage, where a prompt's linguistic surface carries a personality fingerprint the assistant mirrors without access to the personality behind it. Second, we propose the Atomic User Model (AUM), a human-readable representation organising a person as a stable identity nucleus with four interpretable shells (psychological, cognitive and experiential, behavioural, and social), plus cross-shell entries recording internal conflict and authenticity. Third, we treat AUM as a retrieval index over a person rather than a prompt prefix, with a pipeline where a task classifier, component-selection function and budgeted retriever return a small payload of fields at generation time. Fourth, we evaluate it with sixteen language-model-simulated participants, six style-sensitive tasks and three seeds, plus a synthetic scaling study of the retriever. Retrieving eight fields matched the style fidelity of the full user model on 23% of the context (211 tokens against 915), improved on flat preference notes by 0.24 points on a five-point scale (p < 0.001, dz = 0.50), and raised forced-choice identification of the participant's own voice from 14.9% to 42.7% (25% chance). Four pre-registered controls returned null, locating the effect in the representation rather than the search over it. The benefit is largest for participants the un-personalised assistant reproduces worst (rho = -0.61, p = 0.013): personalisation is worth most to those the default serves least.
title: Creating an Atomic User Model for Personality-Aware Large Language Model Interaction
title_translated: 构建人格感知的大语言模型交互的原子用户模型
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的助手被期望以用户风格写作，主流方法是单通道：从对话历史总结偏好并重新插入上下文。这颠倒了推理顺序。偏好是任务依赖的表层特征，而相对稳定的个性结构才是深层基础，因此仅存储偏好的系统在任务变更时需重新学习人物。首先，我们描述了人格渗漏现象，即提示的言语表面携带人格指纹，助手在未访问背后人格的情况下镜像该指纹。其次，我们提出原子用户模型（AUM），一种人类可读的表示方式，将人组织为稳定的身份核心，外加四个可解释的壳层（心理、认知与经验、行为、社会），以及跨壳层条目记录内部冲突与真实性。第三，我们将AUM视为对人的检索索引而非提示前缀，设计了一个流水线：任务分类器、组件选择函数和预算检索器在生成时返回少量字段。第四，我们通过十六名语言模型模拟参与者、六项风格敏感任务和三个种子进行评估，并开展合成规模研究以测试检索器性能。检索八个字段在仅23%的上下文（211 token vs 915）下达到与完整用户模型相当的风格保真度，在五分制评分中比扁平偏好笔记提升0.24分（p < 0.001, dz = 0.50），并将参与者自身声音的强制选择识别率从14.9%提升至42.7%（25%随机基准）。四项预注册控制实验结果为零，表明效果源于表示本身而非搜索过程。对于那些默认助手最无法再现的参与者，个性化收益最大（rho = -0.61, p = 0.013）：个性化对最不受默认服务照顾的人最有价值。

summary: In this study, we examine whether a general shell can outperform specialized tools on enterprise tasks. Shell-based agents have shown strong results in coding, but enterprise work also involves moving between applications and services, coordinating with coworkers, and performing professional analysis. We compare five tool interfaces on TheAgentCompany and APEX-Agents using Opus-4.8 and GPT-5.5: typed tools, typed tools plus bash, bash alone, bash with persistent agent-synthesized tools, and programmatic tool calling (PTC), which runs programs whose actions are restricted to a typed tool catalog. Bash alone outperforms typed tools on both benchmarks, improving score by 21.8-24.5 pp on TheAgentCompany and 4.8-7.4 pp on APEX-Agents while using 19-72% fewer total tokens. Adding typed tools or persistent tool synthesis to bash produces no detectable pooled score gain. PTC uses fewer tokens than direct typed calls with broadly similar task performance, but generally underperforms bash alone in both quality and cost efficiency. For enterprise practitioners, these results favor bash alone when arbitrary execution can be isolated and PTC when security or compliance policies require a fixed tool catalog.
title: Is Bash All You Need? An Empirical Study of Tool Interfaces for Enterprise Digital Worker Agents
title_translated: Bash 就足够了吗？面向企业数字员工代理的工具接口实证研究
summary_translated: 本研究考察通用shell是否能在企业任务中超越专用工具。基于shell的代理在编码任务中表现出色，但企业工作还涉及在应用程序和服务之间切换、与同事协作以及执行专业分析。我们在TheAgentCompany和APEX-Agents基准上，使用Opus-4.8和GPT-5.5比较五种工具接口：键入工具、键入工具加bash、仅bash、带持久代理合成工具的bash，以及程序化工具调用（PTC），后者运行受限于类型化工具目录的程序。仅bash在两个基准上均优于键入工具，使TheAgentCompany得分提高21.8–24.5个百分点，APEX-Agents提高4.8–7.4个百分点，同时总token使用量减少19–72%。向bash添加键入工具或持久工具合成并未带来可检测的综合得分提升。PTC比直接键入调用使用更少token，任务表现大致相当，但在质量和成本效率方面通常不如仅bash。对企业实践者而言，若可隔离任意执行，则推荐仅使用bash；若安全或合规政策要求固定工具目录，则推荐使用PTC。

summary: An agentic coding system couples a language model to a harness: the tools, prompts and control flow that turn a chat model into an autonomous software engineer. Vendors ship harnesses tuned to their own models, and practitioners assume the vendor-native pairing solves more tasks. We measure that assumption with paired same-model contrasts on a private, contamination-controlled suite of 256 repository and post-cutoff contest tasks. The same 80 tasks ran under claude-agent-sdk and under deepagents on claude-opus-4-8, and under the openai-codex SDK and deepagents on gpt-5.5, with gemini-3.5-flash and deepseek-v3.2 as side cells. 792 of 800 planned runs were graded by an isolated oracle. Neither contrast resolves an average advantage for either harness: -1.25 pp for Opus 4.8 (48.8% vs 50.0%, task-bootstrap 95% CI [-10.0, +7.5]) and +1.25 pp for GPT-5.5 (55.6% vs 54.4%, CI [-4.4, +6.9]). The Opus average combines opposite strata: the native harness trails by 9.0 pp on the 61 repository tasks and leads by 23.7 pp on the 19 contest tasks (label-permutation p = 0.003). The partition was chosen after seeing the data and needs a designed replication. Correctness and completion also separate: 22 of 81 runs cancelled at the wall-clock ceiling had produced a passing patch. Re-priced from raw per-turn usage at frozen list prices, the neutral harness cost 1.3 to 1.6 times as much per solved task on Opus 4.8 and 1.2 times on GPT-5.5. These are observed-usage estimates. On the Anthropic account 58 runs left no usage record, and allocating that spend to either cell would move the Opus ratio between 0.7 and 2.3, so the billed ordering is unresolved. This revision corrects an August 2026 manuscript whose cost figures rested on a usage-semantics defect in our own telemetry (Section 5.1). We release the orchestrator, grading oracle, reanalysis code and derived aggregates. The tasks stay private.
title: Harness or Model? Isolating the Harness Effect in Agentic Coding with a Contamination-Controlled Private Suite
